does_not_establish: on-site activity or active governance at 2026-10-30
protected GitHub merge or production deployment

outcomes.governance: Debian Constitution v1.9 fixes leadership, votes, delegates and technical committee
outcomes.limits: Formal general resolutions are developer votes; wider users do not inherit automatic votes.

outcomes.governance: Foundation voters manage OSMF, while the open mapper community creates and revises the data
outcomes.limits: OSMF votes do not govern all edits or grant a privileged say over the map itself.

outcomes.governance: Volunteer editors create the content and content rules; Foundation is not the editorial decision maker
outcomes.limits: Wiki consensus and free content permit enforceable moderation and local article restrictions.

outcomes.governance: Trustees elect foundation bodies; Foundation statutes state free office software and member procedures
outcomes.limits: Trustee rights do not extend automatically to all end users; the 2022 statutes alone cannot certify the 2026 board roster.

outcomes.governance: Official wiki describes do-ocracy, informal trusted decision makers and risk of implicit hierarchy
outcomes.limits: Binding ownership, veto, membership vote and appeal rights over infrastructure remain insufficiently established; no publication upgrade.
